calibrate critics using TRAIN-only fitting worlds and distinct TRAIN validation worlds; freeze tail semantics
report actual accepted actor minibatches, populated-Adam reversal, head-specific gradients, concentration/clamp persistence and physical interventions

real reciprocal trade opportunities survive policy/world changes
